title: A Graphyard fault on another repository's install is reported upstream, never filed as work in that repository
description: Run the real loop cycle for a fixture install of a non-Graphyard repository with a stuck control-plane upgrade on record and a dispatch step that never returns: with upstream configured, a loopback upstream install receives each fault once over HTTP with the upstream credential, however many cycles see it; without it, each fault raises one attention line and nothing is filed again. Nothing is filed into the managed repository, and the master prompt and guide master state the rule.

steps.name: Report a stuck upgrade and a stalled loop step upstream or as an attention line
